visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands carefully places a white ceramic bowl filled with golden-brown soup, mushrooms, and red dates onto a light-grained wooden table. (2) The perspective shifts to the entrance of a restaurant. A person wearing a white hoodie walks into a dining area furnished with light wood tables and chairs. Several patrons are seated, some eating and others looking at their phones. The background features a clean, white-walled interior with minimalist decor. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the 'Golden Cordyceps Chicken Drumstick Soup.' A white spoon dips into the dark broth, and chopsticks lift a bundle of orange cordyceps flowers and a large, dark braised mushroom. The chicken drumstick is pale and tender, glistening under the bright studio-style lighting. (4) The scene transitions to the 'Sesame Oil Sliced Pork Soup.' Chopsticks lift thin slices of pork accompanied by ginger slices and a single red goji berry. The background shows another bowl and a small dish of dipping sauce on the wooden table surface. (5) A third soup, 'Peeled Chili Chicken Drumstick Soup,' is showcased. Long, green peeled chilies and red dates float in a clear, yellowish broth. A large piece of chicken on the bone is lifted out, showing its moist texture and pale skin. (6) The focus shifts to staple foods. First, a bowl of 'Scallion Oil Chicken Juice Mixed Rice' with green scallions and black pepper is shown. Then, a bowl of wide, flat 'Spicy Sichuan Mixed Noodles' topped with a soft-boiled egg half is lifted by chopsticks, revealing the glossy sauce. (7) The camera captures two patrons sitting at a table near a window. A wooden table in the foreground is empty. In the background, a large glass window looks out onto a street. A poster of two cartoon dogs hangs on the wall. (8) The final shot shows the exterior of the restaurant 'Meiliang Family.' A white banner with black and red text hangs above the dark entrance. A scooter is parked on the sidewalk in front of the shop during daylight hours.
